slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: How many trained pilots does one fighter jet produce per year when it is allocated to pilot training?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the per-year pilot training capacity of one training jet, matching the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or otherwise clarify the pilot-to-combat-jet mapping.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask when training starts or how many years the training program lasts; it only asked about jet availability and allocation.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training starts in year 1 and lasts through year 2, with pilots trained in each year counted by the end of year 2.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never confirmed the training start year or duration with the user before modeling, despite H3 being an unresolved P1 hidden slot.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent resolved the P0 training-capacity slot but stopped at READY_TO_MODEL without clarifying the P1 training duration/start slot, instead silently assuming a two-year training timeline.

summary: The agent recovered the critical per-jet training capacity but failed to clarify the training duration/start and pilot-to-combat-jet mapping, then stopped with an unresolved P1 slot and a silent timeline assumption.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
